# Psychiatrist.com

> > Psychiatrist.com is a peer-reviewed publishing platform for clinical psychiatry research, CME education, and evidence-based psychiatric treatment resources.

Psychiatrist.com hosts The Journal of Clinical Psychiatry and The Primary Care Companion for CNS Disorders, offering ACCME-accredited continuing medical education alongside curated clinical reference materials on psychiatric and neurological conditions. The platform serves psychiatrists, primary care physicians, and mental health professionals with peer-reviewed research, case reports, and psychopharmacology insights.

## Key Topics

- Journal of Clinical Psychiatry
- Primary Care Companion for CNS Disorders
- Psychopharmacology
- Antidepressants

## Core Journals & Publishing

- [The Journal of Clinical Psychiatry](https://www.psychiatrist.com/jcp): Landing page for The Journal of Clinical Psychiatry peer-reviewed research.
- [The Primary Care Companion for CNS Disorders](https://www.psychiatrist.com/pcc): Primary Care Companion for CNS Disorders journal landing page.
- [Home](https://www.psychiatrist.com): Homepage for psychiatrist.com, publishing peer-reviewed journals and CME.

## Continuing Medical Education

- [CME Programs](https://www.psychiatrist.com/cme): Continuing Medical Education programs accredited by ACCME and AMA.

## Clinical Reference Topics

- [Depression and Major Depressive Disorder](https://www.psychiatrist.com/depression): MDD research, antidepressant treatments, and psychopharmacology insights.
- [Psychopharmacology](https://www.psychiatrist.com/psychopharmacology): Psychiatric medications, drug development, and psychopharmacology research.
- [Bipolar Disorder](https://www.psychiatrist.com/bipolar-disorder): Bipolar disorder treatment insights and antipsychotic medication research.
- [Anxiety Disorders](https://www.psychiatrist.com/anxiety): GAD and anxiety disorder treatments, research, and management strategies.
- [ADHD](https://www.psychiatrist.com/adhd): ADHD diagnosis, intervention, and treatment strategies for psychiatrists.
- [Addiction and Substance Use Disorders](https://www.psychiatrist.com/addiction): Expert-backed research and treatments for addiction and substance misuse.
- [Alzheimer's Disease](https://www.psychiatrist.com/alzheimers): Alzheimer's research, diagnosis methods, and neuropsychiatric treatments.
- [Obsessive Compulsive Disorder](https://www.psychiatrist.com/ocd): OCD treatment research and evidence-based therapy strategies.
- [Movement Disorders](https://www.psychiatrist.com/movement-disorders): Movement disorders including tardive dyskinesia and Parkinson's disease.
- [Neurology](https://www.psychiatrist.com/neurology): Neurology and psychiatry intersection covering CNS and neurological disorders.
- [Topics Directory](https://www.psychiatrist.com/topics): Directory of psychiatric conditions and clinical topics for reference.
